title: Artificial Intelligence-Based Patient Monitoring System for Medical Support.
summary: Patient monitoring model predicts neurogenic risk with reported measured accuracy. The publisher Methods and Results were checked; this conclusion is limited to the study cohort, reference standard and validation described there. AI role: Recurrent neural network for activity recognition and CNN for risk prediction. The article appeared in International Neurourology Journal.
